title: Origin Bank Welcomes Jami Searle to Fort Walton | Origin Bank
summary: Origin Bank announced today it has hired Jami Searle as Senior Vice President, Commercial Relationship Banker III. Searle joins the team at Origin’s Fort Walton Beach location.
body_markdown:
Origin Bank announced today it has hired Jami Searle as Senior Vice President, Commercial Relationship Banker III. Searle joins the team at Origin’s Fort Walton Beach location.


“Jami brings the kind of experience and focus on relationships that make her a natural fit for the Origin team,” said Robin Donlon, Florida Panhandle Market Leader at Origin Bank. “She understands the needs of local businesses and has facilitated so much growth throughout her career. We’re thrilled to welcome her to Origin and know what an incredible resource she will be for our customers.”


Searle has over 20 years of experience in the financial industry, specializing in financial analysis, real estate lending, working capital lines, equipment financing, as well as managing financing for construction projects and real estate developments. She has worked closely with businesses to understand their cash flow, capital funding and money movement needs, helping them identify financing solutions that support daily operations and long-term growth. In her new role, she will continue to partner with customers to identify and support their financial needs, connecting them with the products and resources best suited to help them achieve their business’s financial goals.


Searle earned a Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration, Finance and Management from Tabor College. She also completed the Graduate School of Banking at LSU and the Florida School of Banking at the University of Florida, where she received the Dr. C. Arnold Matthews Honor Graduate Award.


A resident of Fort Walton Beach, Searle and her husband have two children, Kellen and Kate. She is active in the community, supporting Community Solutions of the Emerald Coast as a Board Member and Co-Treasurer, Impact 100 Northwest Florida as Co-Treasurer, and Trinity United Methodist Church as a member of various committees and substitute accompanist.


Searle is based at Origin’s Fort Walton Beach Financial Center, located at 212 Racetrack Road NW in Fort Walton Beach. For more information or to schedule an appointment, please contact the Fort Walton team at (850) 904-8614.


**About Origin**


Origin Bancorp, Inc. is a financial holding company headquartered in Ruston, Louisiana. Origin’s wholly owned bank subsidiary, Origin Bank, was founded in 1912 in Choudrant, Louisiana. Deeply rooted in Origin’s history is a culture committed to providing personalized relationship banking to businesses, municipalities, and personal clients to enrich the lives of the people in the communities it serves. Origin provides a broad range of financial services and currently operates more than 57 locations in Dallas/Fort Worth, East Texas, Houston, North Louisiana, Mississippi, Alabama and the Florida Panhandle. For more information, visit www.origin.bank. Member FDIC. Equal Housing Lender.
